title: Concept: Lockfile records a dependency the registry marks deprecated
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that carries a deprecation notice, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A deprecated package stops receiving fixes, so defects and advisories in it stay unfixed while the project keeps shipping it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: A deprecated package stops receiving fixes, so defects and advisories in it stay unfixed while the project keeps shipping it.
